entities.summary: Kultura —sometimes referred to as Kultura Paryska —was a leading Polish-émigré literary-political magazine, published from 1947 to 2000 by Instytut Literacki, initially in Rome and then in Paris. It was edited and produced by Jerzy Giedroyc and ceased publication upon his death.
